ModMetaData.name: Couple Beds
ModMetaData.author: Max
ModMetaData.description:
Spouses, fiancés and lovers automatically move into a shared double bed, so they don't get the "Want to sleep with partner" mood penalty.
Smart choice of bed: - prefers a private bedroom (the only bed in the room) over barracks - prefers the most impressive room - never kicks anyone else out of their bed - optionally upgrades a couple to a better free double bed when one appears - also beds pawns who never sleep, who still get the mood penalty (can be turned off)
Settings: Options → Mod settings → Couple Beds. Safe to add or remove mid-save.
